messages: Samir (CEO): Quick weekly — short and tactical. Headline: Private GA still targeted for mid-May but we need a cross-functional readiness pass this week. Priorities: 1) Complete Private GA playbook + compliance checklist (data retention, KMS, audit logs). 2) Stabilize Dedicated p50 latency <= 75ms on customer routes. 3) Hit cost improvement targets (-12% per M tokens) via batching/quantization. Current snapshot: uptime 99.95% (7d), median gen latency down ~8% after runtime kernels, cost/M-token down ~10% in pilot. Immediate asks: Product, Eng, Security — please post status + blockers in this thread by EOD Friday. People Ops — implement a hiring freeze for IC roles; ELT approvals only for exceptions. Town hall Tue 10am PT to announce GA milestone. Thanks team :rocket:
